prompt:
LOCAL GOURD REDESIGN for this exact healer. Image1 is the target. Image2 is the project's healing-gem shape and broad-plane style reference, not a demand for its neon yellow highlight.

FIRST: completely REMOVE the large pale/white leaf-shaped inlay AND its gold outline from the main gourd belly. Do not replace it with any new emblem, medallion, logo, engraving, white patch or eye motif. The main belly must be an elegant QUIET uninterrupted gemstone surface.

REDESIGN SHAPE AND MATERIAL WITH RESTRAINT:
Preserve the enlarged medicinal gourd in the same diagonally tilted SINGLE-ARM hold, large belly lower-left and stoppered mouth upper-right.
Refine its silhouette as a crafted jade vessel: broad softly oval lower belly, smaller upper bulb about half-to-three-fifths the lower belly's width, a clear slender pinched waist and a short neatly tapered neck with a small simple lip. Avoid two identical balls, rigid bottle shoulders or an overly round toy shape. Smooth silhouette with only a few intentional gem-like plane turns, naturally seated along her forearm.
Main body is medium CELADON/JADE GREEN with deeper blue-green/emerald side planes. Desaturate the harsh bright chartreuse/yellow from image1. Use ONE broad softly lit sage-jade upper plane, one mid-green front plane and one deep-green side shadow, about 3–5 large faces total on the big belly. Lower polish: gentle luminous stone depth, not white glass glints, neon glow or many sparkles. Keep enough light/dark difference from the character's leaf-green hair and olive clothing so the vessel remains readable.
Secondary material only at functional joins: a THIN dull warm-gold neck collar and small dark-jade stopper with a warm amber edge. Optional one restrained darker jade band at the narrow waist; no full metal cage, ornate fitting or decorative belt.
Retain a simple dark-green cord tied once around the waist, with one short plain end. No long tassel cluster, beads, pendant or added inset stones. The beauty should come from crafted proportions, clean silhouette and harmonized jade tones, not a large central graphic.
Same project gem-icon rendering: strong clean dark contour, large matte color/value planes with controlled facets, no tiny triangle mosaic, grain, photoreal reflections or overcomplicated ornament.

CHARACTER LOCK:
Do not alter green sprout hairstyle, face/age impression, head/body proportions, dress/capelet/sleeves/leaf prints, sachet, shoes, posture, free relaxed hand or body orientation. Supporting hand can adjust minimally to contact refined vessel; maintain believable one-arm support and exactly two hands. Keep face unobscured. No changes outside the gourd and tiny necessary contact area.
Same full-body square artwork on warm ivory background, complete leaf tips and feet, no new props, symbols or text.
purpose: Remove prominent pale leaf inset and redesign gourd silhouette/material balance with restrained celadon-jade planes and minimal warm-gold functional fittings.
visual_review: Pale leaf inset removed; main gourd now uninterrupted muted celadon/jade planes with darker side, simple dark-jade cap and restrained gold collar; single-arm tilt retained.
